_week: 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-15 (Week 46, Monday–Sunday), Dormeo Canada, CAD. Written from that week's numbers.
week_story: Revenue rose 14% to $61.3K on 116 units (93 the week before). Octaspring Queen sold 54 units vs 43 and made half of sales.
Octaspring Full nearly doubled to $10.8K (20 units vs 10); SnowTek & Essentials fell to $686 with the SnowTek Queen out of stock.
refunds: Refunds were $4,978 on 13 units (11.3% refund rate), up from $4,062 on 11 units (12.0%) last week. Net payout rose 5% to $30.9K.
pacing_reco: November is at $122.1K through Nov 15, 9% behind the same days last year ($134.5K). Queen stock and BF/CM deals are the levers to close it.
ads_context: Ad spend rose 51% to $5,823 while ad sales rose 8% to $40,084.
ACoS rose to 14.5% (from 10.4%) and TACoS to 9.5% (from 7.2%); ads drove 65% of revenue.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords brought $27,141 in sales on $2,587 (9.5% ACoS) and 52 ad orders.
